name: Titanium
description: Diamond tier. Set bonus: Unbreakable Will

pages.title: Titanium
pages.text:
The reliable workhorse: diamond-level gear that almost never breaks.

- **Tier:** Diamond
- **Durability:** 3000
- **Sword damage:** 7
- **Armor (full set):** 20

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text:
**Titanium Ore** is rare, deep underground between Y -64 and Y -16, in small, mostly buried veins. Mine it with a diamond pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw titanium.

Titanium gear is the base for [Infernium](entry://materials/infernium).

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Tools:** diamond tier and speed, with 3000 durability (about twice diamond), but low enchantability.
- **Armor:** diamond-level protection with extra toughness (2.5 per piece) and a little knockback resistance.
- **Shield:** 1000 durability, and axes disable it for less than half the usual time.

pages.title: Unbreakable Will
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** Everything you use loses 50%% less durability. Dropping below 30%% health gives Resistance I for 5 seconds (once a minute).
A blast furnace works too, and is faster.
